comment: The examples assume that foundational systems expose modern APIs and that health systems can access them. Some countries rely on batch files, messaging, manual processes, or restricted government networks.

anchor.note: p.97 l.Lines 345-352 read as the printed page; section 4.3.4 agrees

public.text: The examples assume that foundational systems expose modern APIs and that health systems can access them. Some countries rely on batch files, messaging, manual processes, or restricted government networks.
public.suggestedRevision: Allow several governed integration patterns, including APIs, secure messaging, events, batch exchange, and transitional manual verification, with a documented progression path.
